lines.en: I walk the slope of the Ashen Valley.
The ash underfoot is soft.

lines.zh: 灰落在我裂开的背甲上。
lines.en: Ash settles in the cracks of my shell.
I pick my way through the dead wood.

lines.zh: 风把我的外壳吹得发烫。
lines.en: The wind bakes my shell hot.
I go around a charred trunk.
Embers still glow on the ground.
I walk through the ash.
My steps stay very low.
There's little footing in the ashen wood.
I walk down the ash slope toward you.
A little smoke rises under me.
I lie on the ground without moving.
Ash settles on my back.

lines.zh: 我在听木头裂开的声音。
lines.en: I listen to the wood cracking.
The wind here is always hot.
I tuck my limbs in.

lines.zh: 我把鼻子凑近干裂的地。
lines.en: I put my snout to the cracked ground.
The Ashen Valley is quiet.

lines.zh: 我呼出的气把草烤卷了。
lines.en: My breath curls the grass dry.
Embers glow against me.

lines.zh: 灰谷的坡很软，我贴着走。
lines.en: The ash valley slope is soft; I keep low.
You're standing in the ash.
Your soles will burn through.

lines.zh: 灰谷的热气，从我身边起。
lines.en: The heat of the Ash Valley starts at my side.
You don't smell of smoke.
You're not from here.
I slowly tilt my head.
Get back past the ash heap.
The heat in me will burn you.
I lift my head as you step away.
That was the right move.
You struck my shell.
A new crack in the shell.
I gave half a step in the ash.
It's only on the shell's surface.
You shook the ash loose.
I pull my head behind my shell's rim.
My shell splits and heat escapes.
My legs still hold me.
That one burned into my shell.
The heat in me hasn't faded.
Whatever's in your hand, I don't eat it.
There's nothing to eat in the ash.
The sweetness creeps into my snout.
Holding it that high? You're teasing fire.
I'm not very hungry.
I don't touch these.
Holding it up won't help.
I keep lying here.

lines.zh: 这点分量，我一口就没了。
lines.en: That much would be gone in one bite.
My nostrils flare and close.
Your hit sent heat along my shell's rim.
Not even a pale mark on my shell.

lines.zh: 你退开的时候烫到手了吧。
lines.en: Your hand burnt as you pulled back, didn't it?
Don't step on my baked shell.
I shift my body into the ash.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，灰飞起来。
lines.en: We collided and ash flew up.
You're covered in ash now too.
I lower myself slowly.
You jumped over me.
Your landing raised a cloud of ash.

lines.zh: 这片灰谷没几只我这样的。
lines.en: Few like me in this ashen valley.
Not in the Ashen Valley.

lines.zh: 我大部分时候都在伏着。
lines.en: I'm usually lying low.
Walk away.
Wait until the wind dies down.
Ash covers everything.
I turn around.
Don't follow my prints.
The valley has only this road.

lines.zh: 灰谷的热风，推我往前走。
lines.en: The Ash Valley's hot wind pushes me on.

lines.zh: 我咬下去，牙被硌了一下。
lines.en: I bite down and jar my teeth.
This isn't stone.
It fell from your hand.
I push it under the hot ash.
So bright. Too conspicuous.

lines.zh: 我用鼻子把它顶了回去。
lines.en: I nudge it back with my snout.
Too heavy. I can't drag it.
Then I'll leave it.
I sweep it into the ash.
The ash will cover it.
You just crushed an ember.
Your steps come through the ash.
There are no echoes in the Ashen Valley.
I slowly raise my head.
I turn toward you.
My shell is heating up.
You'd better leave now.
Getting up takes me a moment.
Run in that time.

lines.zh: 我的热气已经喷到你脚边。
lines.en: My hot breath already reaches your feet.
My forepaws press into the ash.
There's nothing else to chase here.
So you became what I'm after.
Ashen Woods embers burn along with me.

lines.zh: 你背靠的那截木头在烧。
lines.en: That log at your back is burning.
No need to run that fast.
I follow low along the ash.
Your footprints show clearly.
I follow them.
You ran uphill.
The ash is thicker up there.
Your feet will sink.
Ashen Valley fire burns on my back.
The heat in me dries the ash.
You turned and saw my heat.
A few steps of ash between us.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸在发抖，灰烬谷的火在烧。
lines.en: Your breathing shakes; the Ashen Valley burns.
The ash path is nearly done.
I go around the charred stump.
The heat lights everything around me.
You can't hide now.
I'm right against you.
I stop to catch my breath.
The ash is too thick to move fast.
Your prints are getting deeper.
All I need is to follow you.
I lunge out of the ash.
My claws grazed your leg.
That one carried heat.
The heat made you pull your hand back.
I slammed into you.
My body is heavier than yours.
You backed to the ash pit's edge.
I press down once more.
Your hand is on the ground.
The ground is still hot.
I butt you aside.
My tail sweeps up a sheet of ash.
You coughed twice.
I press you into the ash.
Now you're underneath.
I raise my claw.
Ash spills between my claws.
I lower myself closer.
You can barely get up.
I swing my head and ram with my shell's horn.
I rise out of the ash heap.
Ash slides off my back.
I land in a cloud of ash.

lines.zh: 我身上的热把周围照亮。
lines.en: The heat in me lights the surroundings.
There's no moonlight in the Ashen Valley night.
You're standing in the middle of the ash.
I turn my body toward you.

lines.zh: 我背上的壳先热了起来。
lines.en: The shell on my back heats up first.
Best not to come too close.

lines.zh: 灰谷的风，把我的灰吹走。
lines.en: Ashen Valley wind blows my ash off.

lines.zh: 这里的木头都烧成了黑。
lines.en: The wood here is burned black.
I shift one step your way.

lines.zh: 这片地本来就烧，我早就习惯了。
lines.en: This land already burns. I'm used to it.

lines.zh: 从灰坡滚下来，我一点事没有。
lines.en: I rolled down the ash slope without harm.

lines.zh: 这里的水是热的，我赶紧爬出来。
lines.en: The water here is hot. I scrambled out.

lines.zh: 爆炸把灰云推过来，我伏低。
lines.en: The blast pushed an ash cloud over. I flattened.
The arrowhead stuck in my shell's seam.

lines.zh: 一道光打过我，我身上更烫了。
lines.en: A flash crossed me and I grew hotter.

lines.zh: 灰里没有吃的，我越来越虚。
lines.en: Nothing to eat in the ash. I'm weakening.

lines.zh: 雷落在灰谷里，我整只都震了。
lines.en: Lightning struck the valley and shook through me.
No ground here, and no ash.
